text:
I came to this clinic two years ago for a front lower tooth implant. The implant they installed kept moving and falling out, and the doctor just kept putting it back in. Later, he said a nearby tooth was the problem, so he removed it and placed another implant, but it still did not fix the issue.

Later doctor said the solution should be the bridge. He installed a bridge on an implant and my natural tooth.

The problems never ended and I changed clinic. Doctors at another clinic were shocked because NOONE DOES BRIDGES ON NATURAL TOOTH AND IMPLANT.
When the damaged implant was removed a year ago (by the same doctor who installed it), part of it was left inside, which caused a jawbone infection for more than a year.

I regularly came for check ups. The doctor regularly did x-ray. HOW COME HE DIDN’T SEE AN INFECTION? He kept on prescribing me antibiotics and paracetamol.

Now I have problems with four teeth instead of one, and I also need a crown on the damaged natural tooth. I don’t know how many thousand I have to spend to fix what was done here.

Maybe this clinic is fine for cleanings, but I would not trust them with serious procedures.

(The black hole under the tooth is infection that was spreading all this time.)
